check: The remainder is 48 - 17 - 10 = 21 backpacks. Revenue is 17 × $18 + 10 × $25 + 21 × $22 = $1,018, so profit is $1,018 - $576 = $442.
error_description: Step 3 incorrectly calculates the remainder as 11 instead of 21 backpacks. This understates revenue and profit by $220, producing the incorrect $222 profit.
